prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Full game interior background, landscape 16:9 at about 1536x864. Input 1 is the existing interior composition/theme reference; input 2 is the approved NEW sketchbook medium and twilight palette. Fully REDRAW the scene as genuine rough graphite and colored pencil concept art, visible crosshatching, imperfect overlapping pencil outlines, irregular pigment and discreet gray paper grain, strong charcoal black masses with substantial muted violet color and warm amber candles/lanterns. Not a color filter, not pixel art, not polished digital painting, not realistic photography. Preserve the identity and recognizable age/face/role of the attendant when present, and keep their face and torso fully visible in the LEFT 35 percent of the image at roughly x 0.20 y 0.48. Keep the top 12 percent calm for the menu. The entire RIGHT 43 percent (x 0.57 to 0.98, y 0.20 to 0.97) must be quiet dark low-detail wall/canvas negative space for a tall two-column two-row hero card grid; no face, large furnishings, lit windows, bright decor or baked-in UI there. The attendant belongs to a civilian camp at dusk; preserve theme while simplifying excessive gold ornament into pencil marks and violet cloth. Objects have readable silhouettes with intentional handmade uneven lines. No writing, no logo, no labels, no UI, no cards baked into image, no watermark. Lighting should match sunset outside and amber lanterns inside, black/gray/violet dominant with controlled warm accents. Theme: elderly bearded sly merchant in a charcoal violet hood, leaning at his counter on the LEFT, books, bottles, a few violet crystals, a small cyan soul lantern, simple brass scales, civilian trading shop
